reason: The cited lines describe a read-only search tool over indexed public GitHub issues, pull requests, README content, and public code repositories, returning ranked results. That supports UNTRUSTED because public GitHub content can be attacker-controlled. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution, access to non-public/user-private data, or delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination; they instead characterize the tools as read-only search.
